ownership.policy: All registered engineering skills are subordinate modules governed, selected, sequenced, evaluated and certified only through the Cyborg executor.

orchestrator.purpose: Canonical vendor-neutral owner and execution orchestrator of the VibeSchool engineering skill system.

core.purpose: Inspect current code, types, tests, migrations, workflows, PR state and CI before changing anything.
Validate fixtures, mocks, payloads, interfaces, DB schemas, RPCs and API shapes against current canonical definitions; forbid stale remembered shapes.
Require agents to discover and extend canonical authority/execution components instead of creating competing gateways, admission paths, evidence stores, certification ledgers or runtime controllers.
Enforce isolated-branch delivery, exact-head CI, freshness checks, exact verified-head merge and post-merge verification; stale evidence cannot authorize merge or certification.
Keep runtime, schedulers, automatic publishing, payments and consequential authority default-denied unless explicitly commissioned; coding or merge authority never implies activation authority.
Bind IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, CERTIFIED, MERGE READY, MERGED, POST-MERGE VERIFIED and PRODUCTION READY claims to fresh evidence appropriate to their exact scope and SHA.
Require narrow tests, typecheck, lint, relevant build and changed-file validation before claiming ready for CI.
Prove new tests fail when protected behavior is deliberately broken; reject decorative tests.
Fetch the exact failed job/log, classify root cause, repair the canonical cause, rerun and repeat until green or genuinely blocked.
Enforce exact-head evidence and strict meanings for IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, CERTIFIED, MERGED and BLOCKED.
When later work reveals an earlier defect, repair the earlier canonical layer first, invalidate stale certification and re-certify dependents.
Scan for unsafe type escapes, ignored diagnostics, skipped tests, disabled lint, swallowed errors, weakened assertions, bypass mocks and unsafe feature flags.
Verify RLS, tenant isolation, authz, service-role use, capability grants, owner gates, secrets, destructive operations and fail-closed behavior.
Forbid merge until required checks are green on current head, review obligations are satisfied and merge result is verified.
Turn preventable failure classes into permanent regression cases or preflight rules whenever practical.
Avoid unnecessary deploys, paid AI, destructive DB actions and expensive external calls when cheaper proof is sufficient.

agentCore.purpose: Compile broad natural-language intent into a typed mission, atomic requirement ledger, dependency map and evidence contract.
Forbid final readiness/completion answers while mandatory requirements, contradictions, evidence freshness or learning closure remain unresolved.
Continue diagnose-repair-reverify loops through recoverable failures until COMPLETE or a genuine typed boundary.
Maintain append-only hash-chained mission history and provenance for consequential actions and evidence.
Update institutional knowledge, decisions, incidents, regressions and debt while invalidating stale or contradicted knowledge.
Distinguish product failure from connector, CI, environment, timeout and external-provider failure and change strategy instead of blind reruns.
Checkpoint mission state, make retryable consequential actions safe, and allow another model/chat to resume from durable state.
Use mutable-scope leases, detect overlapping work and preserve unrelated concurrent missions.

vibeschoolDomains.purpose: Govern worker authority, runtime admission, approvals, watchdogs, retries, clarification, fallback and commissioning.
Protect schema, migrations, RLS, grants, tenant isolation, service-role boundaries, auth and data integrity.
Protect curriculum identity, source fidelity, quality gates, independent review, publishing state and learner-facing content integrity.
Ensure HQ states reflect real commissioned, authorized, available, working, blocked and certified truth with usable evidence.
Protect end-to-end Teacher, Student, Parent and School Admin journeys and shared identity/data contracts.
Require safe rollout, rollback, environment verification, migration safety, exact-head deployment evidence and post-release checks.
Require telemetry freshness, heartbeat health, failure visibility, watchdog independence and recovery evidence.
